R Parity is not a symmetry of nature, but it is a symmetry of the vacuum.
R Parity violation can be a natural consequence of supersymmetry and it is the only mechanism which can explain the solar and atmospheric neutrinos anomalies.
R Parity breaking in the neutrino sector is a natural and predictive solution of neutrino mass and oscillation data which can be clearly probed at the LHC and future colliders.

the R Parity violating interactions are the key to the understanding of neutrino masses, mixings and the nature of neutrinoless double beta decay.
